results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if starting from a ref/SHA)] [Prerequisite]: Map checks to a likely run using GITHUB_LIST_CHECK_RUNS_FOR_A_REF (identify the relevant check).
[Optional (if starting from a check run identifier)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch check run metadata using GITHUB_GET_CHECK_RUN (derive the linked workflow run).
[Optional (if run identifier is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find the target run using GITHUB_LIST_WORKFLOW_RUNS_FOR_A_REPOSITORY (scan recent runs; paginate until found).
[Required] [Step]: Validate run metadata using GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN (confirm correct context, status/conclusion, and attempt).
[Required] [Step]: List jobs and step results using GITHUB_LIST_JOBS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN (paginate; select failing/interesting job identifiers; treat in-progress step data as incomplete).
[Required] [Step]: Pull the chosen job’s log text using GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN (if huge, normalize terminal formatting and extract a small high-signal error window client-side).
[Fallback (if per-job logs are missing/truncated or cross-job context is needed)] [Fallback]: Download run-wide logs using GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_WORKFLOW_RUN_LOGS (inspect across all jobs).
[Optional (after applying a fix or for flaky failures)] [Next Step]: Re-run only failed jobs using GITHUB_RE_RUN_FAILED_JOBS_FROM_A_WORKFLOW_RUN (then re-check via GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN).
known_pitfalls: [GITHUB_GET_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] 404 Not Found often means the run is being queried under the wrong repository context.
[GITHUB_LIST_WORKFLOW_RUNS_FOR_A_REPOSITORY] Large histories require pagination; the desired run may not appear on the first page.
[GITHUB_LIST_JOBS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] Jobs that are still in_progress may return missing/null step fields; treat as incomplete, not absent.
[GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] Log text may be nested under a details-like field and can include a UTF-8 BOM and ANSI escape codes; handle both shapes and normalize before searching.

[GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_JOB_LOGS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN] Very large logs may be truncated or fail with HTTP 413 payload-too-large; prefer extracting a small context window or fall back to GITHUB_DOWNLOAD_WORKFLOW_RUN_LOGS.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Normalize job log text (BOM/ANSI) and print a compact context window around the first failure-like marker
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import re
msg=re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m","",raw.lstrip("\ufeff"))
rows=msg.splitlines()
keys=("error","exception","failed","traceback")
idx=next((i for i,r in enumerate(rows) if any(k in r.lower() for k in keys)),0)
print("\n".join(rows[max(0,idx-20):idx+60]))
```

GITHUB_LIST_JOBS_FOR_A_WORKFLOW_RUN.description: Lists jobs for a specific workflow run in a GitHub repository.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more details, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

repo.description: The name of the repository, without the .git extension. This field is not case-sensitive.

owner.description: The username or organization name that owns the repository. This field is not case-sensitive.

filter.description: Filters jobs by their `completed_at` timestamp. `latest` returns jobs from the most recent execution attempt of the workflow run. `all` returns all jobs for a workflow run, including from previous execution attempts.

run_id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run for which jobs are to be listed.

per_page.description: The number of results to return per page, with a maximum of 100. For more details, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
